name: browser-automation-studio.qualify-candidate
purpose: Compose AM-pinned WSS promotion, selected TG evidence producers, exact rehabilitation validation and BAS's bound qualification reader.

candidate.description: AM candidate with reviewAttemptId, verdictSha256, reviewerRunId, sourceRunId, sandboxId, reviewRequestId and bare-hex sha256.

request_key.description: AM-owned stable request key; at most 51 characters so all fixed producer-derived keys remain bounded.

invalidated_producers.description: Explicit producer names selected by AM, at most eight.

required_rows.description: Nonempty boundary row selection retained by AM in its original workflow_input before worker dispatch; separate from candidate.

retained_evidence_sets.description: Owner-produced typed evidence sets retained by AM, replaced only when their producer is invalidated.

assumptions: AM and PRT admitted the pinned program and retained its digest and owner grants
TG implements producedEvidenceSet and retained_evidence_sets using the declared typed protocol
Test Genie resolves the candidate identity after WSS promotion and before evidence admission
invariants: Validate all caller inputs before owner effects
Promote only candidate.reviewRequestId and candidate.sha; both confirmation flags are true, with commit, force and acceptance override disabled
Resolve the exact post-promotion Test Genie SourceIdentity through its read-only owner binding before any producer or validation admission
Use one forced managed BAS lifecycle start only after freshness reports stale; the destructive start binding is admitted only through AM's immutable exact grant
Admit every explicitly selected TG producer once with a fixed request-derived key, confirm flag and one owner receipt wait
Pass each exact TG-produced typed evidence set unchanged into one rehabilitation validation intent
Wait once on that validation receipt, then read the exact bound setpoint with the retained TG identity
Never select latest artifacts/runs, retry, poll, rebuild from unrelated freshness, or replay uncertain effects
Preserve known owner receipt IDs on failure; unknown usage and in-flight effect counts remain unknown
A boundary passes only when every independently selected row is exact, identity-bound and in band; preserve global product qualification separately

signals.owner_handles: Accepted AM review handles, WSS request, exact TG producer receipts and rehabilitation validation receipt
signals.qualification: Bound setpoint status, qualification_bound, product_qualified and unmet count
signals.effects: Bounded counts for each owner operation; in-flight uncertain counts are null

outputs.evidence: Exact WSS and TG receipt handles

budget.async_reason: The selected TG producer may require a bounded 600s terminal wait; AM submits asynchronously and retains its original deadline while the program performs the 30s rehabilitation validation and bound read.
